Game Overview

Black Hole Attack puts players into a fun experience centered on engage in rapid strategy within a captivating arcade world as you guide an all-consuming black hole. Quickly amass weapons before confronting intense boss battles, where speed and quick thinking are key. Test your reflexes and climb the leaderboard while mastering this thrilling, fast-paced adventure.
